# **Experiment No. 4**

## **Experiment Title:**

Use function types, scope, and closures; apply try-catch; build a palindrome checker.  

## **Software / Tools Required:**

1. Visual Studio Code (VS Code)  
2. Google Chrome  
3. HTML5  
4. CSS3  
5. JavaScript (ES6)

**Experiment Program Code (Palindrome Checker):**

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>

\<html lang\="en"\>

\<head\>

    \<meta charset\="UTF-8"\>

    \<meta name\="viewport" content\="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"\>

    \<title\>Palindrome Checker\</title\>

    \<link rel\="stylesheet" href\="vehicle.css"\>

\</head\>

\<body\>

\<div class\="login-box"\>

    \<h2\>Palindrome Checker\</h2\>

    \<form id\="palindromeForm"\>

        \<label\>Enter a Word\</label\>

        \<input type\="text" id\="text" placeholder\="Enter text"\>

        \<button type\="submit"\>Check\</button\>

    \</form\>

    \<p id\="result"\>\</p\>

\</div\>

\<script\>

document.getElementById("palindromeForm").addEventListener("submit", function(event){

    event.preventDefault();

    let text \= document.getElementById("text").value.toLowerCase();

    let result \= document.getElementById("result");

    try{

        if(text\==""){

            throw "Please enter a word";

        }

        let reverse \= text.split("").reverse().join("");

        if(text \!== reverse){

            throw "Not a Palindrome";

        }

        result.style.color \= "green";

        result.innerHTML \= "Palindrome Valid\<br\>Submitted by 24070521043\<br\>Mohammed Zaid Shaikh";

    }

    catch(error){

        result.style.color \= "red";

        result.innerHTML \= error;

    }

});

\</script\>

\</body\>

\</html\>

**Case Study Title:**

Vehicle Registration Number Validation Webpage using Functions, Scope, and Try-Catch

## **Vehicle Number Validation**

### **Accepts User Input Such As:**

1. Vehicle Number

### **It Performs:**

1. Validates the vehicle number format.  
2. Displays a success message for a valid vehicle number.  
3. Displays an error message for an invalid vehicle number using **try-catch**.

**Case Study Program Code (Vehicle Validation):**

**vehicle.html (JS and HTML)**

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>

\<html\>

\<head\>

    \<title\>Vehicle Number Validation\</title\>

    \<link rel\="stylesheet" href\="vehicle.css"\>

\</head\>

\<body\>

\<div class\="login-box"\>

    \<h2\>Vehicle Validation\</h2\>

    \<form id\="vehicleForm"\>

        \<label\>Vehicle Number\</label\>

        \<input type\="text" id\="vehicle" placeholder\="MH31FZ6849"\>

        \<button type\="submit"\>Validate\</button\>

    \</form\>

    \<p id\="result"\>\</p\>

\</div\>

\<script\>

    document.getElementById("vehicleForm").addEventListener("submit", function(event){

    event.preventDefault();

    let vehicle \= document.getElementById("vehicle").value.toUpperCase();

    let result \= document.getElementById("result");

    try{

        let pattern \= /^\[A-Z\]{2}\[0-9\]{2}\[A-Z\]{2}\[0-9\]{4}$/;

        if(\!pattern.test(vehicle)){

            throw "Invalid Vehicle Number";

        }

        result.style.color \= "green";

result.innerText \= \`Valid Vehicle Number ✅

Submitted by 24070521043

Mohammed Zaid Shaikh\`;

    }

    catch(error){

        result.style.color \= "red";

        result.innerHTML \= error;

    }

});

\</script\>

\</body\>

\</html\>

## **Result / Conclusion**

The practical was completed successfully. The concepts of **functions, variable scope, closures, and exception handling using try-catch** were implemented. A vehicle number validation program was developed that accepts user input, validates the vehicle registration number, and displays appropriate success or error messages accurately using JavaScript
